pose_transport: gz.transport13 native Pose_V; no TF conversion
coordinate_frame: Native Gazebo world positions in metres from /world/sydney_regatta/pose/info
callback_boundary: Background callback enqueues receipt time/message; main thread validates and writes all CSV/state
raw_phase_definition: CSV phase is the main-thread processing stage, not a native sample-time segment label
segment_definition: After closing raw CSV, select usable native header stamps in half-open publication-clock intervals; exclude pre-protocol and post-stop samples. Boundaries are ROS publication times, not simulator acknowledgement.
observation_qos: ROS clock BEST_EFFORT/VOLATILE depth 1000, Image depth 1 for first frame; native GZ pose subscription; no lossless-transport claim
boundary: ROS publications, actual model-pose differences and a received rendered Image are separate evidence; no general causal, energy, collision or real-vessel claim
